title: Rubber Roller Refurbishment, Recovery & Precision Regrinding
tagline: Restore performance. Extend roller life. Reduce replacement costs.
intro: Industrial rubber rollers experience wear, surface damage, hardening, and changes in their operating characteristics over time. In many cases, the underlying metal core and shaft remain serviceable even when the rubber covering requires replacement.
Sync Manufacturing provides rubber roller refurbishment and precision regrinding services through our Carson City, Nevada manufacturing operation.

By combining rubber compounding, rubber-to-metal bonding, machining, and precision finishing, we help equipment manufacturers and industrial operators restore existing rollers to the requirements of their applications.
summary: Sync Manufacturing provides rubber roller refurbishment and precision regrinding services through our Carson City, Nevada manufacturing operation.

blocks.text: Depending on roller condition, construction, and application requirements, our services include:

items.text: Restoring roller geometry, surface condition, and dimensional characteristics.
items.label: Precision roller regrinding

items.text: Evaluating replacement compounds based on hardness, wear, chemical exposure, temperature, and operating conditions.

items.label: Metal core and shaft evaluation

sections.heading: When Should a Rubber Roller Be Refurbished?

blocks.text: A roller may be a candidate for refurbishment when it exhibits:

items.text: Surface wear, cuts, or localized damage
Hardening or deterioration of the rubber covering
Uneven wear or changes in roller profile
Loss of traction or inconsistent contact pressure
Dimensional changes that affect machine performance

blocks.text: Not every roller can be economically refurbished. Our team evaluates the condition of the roller and the customer's application requirements before recommending an appropriate manufacturing approach.
Our roller refurbishment capabilities may support equipment used in:

items.title: Preserve existing components
body: When the core and shaft remain suitable for reuse, recovering can avoid the expense of manufacturing an entirely new roller assembly.

items.title: Restore operating characteristics
body: Appropriate rubber materials and precision finishing can help restore the surface and dimensional characteristics required for the application.

items.title: Support equipment continuity
body: Refurbishment provides an additional sourcing option for specialized rollers, particularly where replacement assemblies require custom manufacturing.

items.title: Evaluate material improvements
body: When appropriate, refurbishment offers an opportunity to review existing elastomer specifications and evaluate alternatives suited to the equipment's operating environment.

closing.title: Request a Roller Refurbishment Evaluation
body: Have a worn, damaged, or discontinued industrial roller?
Send us your roller dimensions, photographs, available drawings, material specifications, and application requirements.
Our team can evaluate whether recovering, regrinding, or replacement manufacturing is the appropriate solution.
